title: Leadership & Innovator Series: Guillaume Pousaz, Founder & CEO, Checkout.com
description:
Real conversations. Real insights.


This series welcomes global bank executives, FinTech founders, influencers and change-makers to share their vision on the future of financial services.


In this edition, we speak to Guillaume Pousaz, Founder and CEO, Checkout.com. Guillaume believes that financial complexity is a barrier to innovation which is blocking economic prosperity. He founded Checkout.com in 2012 to cut through banking complexity and empower businesses to change the world.


Join us to hear from Guillaume on his personal journey, all about checkout.com, his vision of the future and much more!
